rationale: X reports zero findings and never engages with the two things human reviewers actually flagged (need for regression tests, need for a tags enum) despite both being visible as freshly-added code in the diff, so it adds no value. Y is deeply grounded, cites specific files/lines, and independently surfaces that the hardware-gated tests don't run in standard CI (echoing SamitHuang's test concern) and that the CuMemTag enum is only half-used (echoing Gaohan123's enum concern); critically, Y's #1 finding flags that the strict NotImplementedError guard on level-2 wake can permanently brick the engine on the default path — exactly the over-strictness that later caused issue #4905/#4912, satisfying the latent gap check that human review missed.
